name: Exp_BW-wiseMan-1
summary: This EA trades based on the BW-wiseMan-1 custom indicator, which is derived from Bill Williams' Alligator indicator (jaw, teeth, lips). It generates buy signals when the upper buffer has a non-empty value and sell signals when the lower buffer has a non-empty value, with an option to trade retrogradely (against the trend). Positions are opened and closed based on these signals with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BW-wiseMan-1自定义指标进行交易，该指标源自比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标（颌、齿、唇）。当上轨缓冲区有非空值时产生买入信号，当下轨缓冲区有非空值时产生卖出信号，并提供逆势交易选项。根据这些信号开仓和平仓，配有可配置的止损止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标，通过三条不同周期的平滑移动平均线（颌线13周期、齿线8周期、唇线5周期）判断市场趋势状态。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区出现有效信号值时做多，下轨缓冲区出现有效信号值时做空，信号由鳄鱼线的排列关系和back参数指定的K线数量分析产生。特别的是，retrogradely参数允许逆势交易，即反转指标缓冲区的读取顺序，将顺势信号转为逆势信号。出场条件包括止损止盈的硬性出场，以及通过回溯历史K线寻找反向信号来触发平仓。仓位管理采用MM参数控制每笔交易占用资金比例，支持固定手数和百分比两种模式（LOT模式和其他保证金模式）。资金管理通过StopLoss和TakeProfit参数设定固定点数的止损止盈，Deviation参数控制最大滑点容忍度。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on Bill Williams' Alligator indicator, using three smoothed moving averages of different periods (jaw 13, teeth 8, lips 5) to determine market trend states. Entry conditions are: go long when the upper buffer of the indicator produces a valid signal value, and go short when the lower buffer produces a valid signal value, with signals generated from the alignment relationship of the Alligator lines and analysis of the number of bars specified by the back parameter. Notably, the retrogradely parameter allows counter-trend trading by reversing the read order of the indicator buffers, converting trend-following signals into counter-trend ones. Exit conditions include hard exits via stop loss and take profit, as well as closing positions by searching backward through historical bars for opposing signals. Position sizing uses the MM parameter to control the share of deposit per trade, supporting both fixed lot and percentage-based margin modes. Money management employs StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters for fixed point-based exits, while the Deviation parameter controls the maximum allowable price slippage.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算方法（固定手数或百分比）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation method (fixed lots/balance/free margin etc.)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 基于经典的比尔·威廉姆斯鳄鱼指标，理论基础成熟，广泛应用于趋势识别
提供丰富的参数控制，包括买卖方向开关、逆势交易选项、手数计算模式等，灵活性高
有止损止盈保护机制，且默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险收益比设置为1:2较为合理
通过IsNewBar机制在每根新K线时才计算信号，避免了逐tick重复计算，减少资源消耗
支持逆势和顺势两种交易模式，适应不同市场行情
pros_en: Based on the classic Bill Williams Alligator indicator with mature theoretical foundation widely used for trend identification
Provides rich parameter controls including buy/sell direction switches, counter-trend option, and lot calculation modes for high flexibility
Includes stop loss and take profit protection with default SL 1000 and TP 2000 points, achieving a reasonable 1:2 risk-reward ratio
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to calculate signals only on new bars, avoiding per-tick redundant computation and reducing resource consumption
Supports both trend-following and counter-trend trading modes to adapt to different market conditions
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标BW-wiseMan-1，指标源码不可见，策略逻辑的完整透明度不足
回溯历史K线寻找反向信号来触发平仓的逻辑可能效率低下，在K线数量很多时循环开销大
缺少点差过滤机制，在点差较大时可能以不利价格入场，尤其对逆势交易影响更大
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓，导致仓位叠加风险
SignalBar默认值为1意味着使用已收盘K线信号，但设为0时在当前K线信号可能频繁变化导致反复交易
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator BW-wiseMan-1 whose source code is not visible, reducing full transparency of the strategy logic
The backward historical bar search for opposing signals to trigger position closes may be inefficient with large loop overhead when bar count is high
Lacks spread filtering mechanism, potentially entering at unfavorable prices during wide spreads, especially impactful for counter-trend trades
No position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction and causing position stacking risk
SignalBar defaults to 1 using closed bar signals, but setting to 0 may cause frequent signal changes on the current bar leading to repeated trading
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓，避免不利滑点成本
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过度集中
对历史K线回溯搜索添加最大搜索范围限制，防止循环时间过长影响交易执行效率
improvements_en: Add spread filtering to pause entry when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding unfavorable slippage costs
Add position check logic to prevent duplicate same-direction entries that cause excessive position concentration
Add a maximum search range limit for the historical bar backward search to prevent excessive loop duration affecting trade execution efficiency

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标，若指标文件缺失或版本不匹配将导致EA无法运行
逆势交易模式默认开启，可能在强趋势行情中产生连续亏损
缺少持仓检查和重复开仓保护，可能导致仓位叠加风险
回溯搜索平仓信号时无范围限制，极端情况下可能影响交易执行时效性
risk_points_en: Dependency on external custom indicator means EA cannot run if the indicator file is missing or version mismatched
Counter-trend trading mode is enabled by default, potentially causing consecutive losses during strong trending markets
Lack of position check and duplicate entry protection may lead to position stacking risk
Unbounded backward search for close signals may affect trade execution timeliness in extreme cases
